stories.title: Apple Patches for October 2026, (Mon, Oct 26th)
stories.description: Apple today released patches for 304 vulnerabilties. This number is still in line with prior Apple updates, and comes just about a month after the last apple update.

stories.title: Hackers Weaponize Public PHP2Shell Exploit Code to Target Universities and Business Websites
stories.description: Hackers exploit PHP2Shell flaws to attack university and business websites, using public code to execute commands on unpatched servers.

stories.title: Anthropic Files for Potentially the Biggest IPO Ever as CEO Warns of Risk to Humanity From AI
stories.description: A string of hacking incidents by rogue AI agents also has raised fears the technology will slip free of human control to carry out harmful, life-threatening tasks.

stories.title: Hackers Infect 953 Online Stores With Scanner-Evading JavaScript, Mostly on Magento
stories.description: Hackers infected 953 online stores with JavaScript loaders hidden in Magento CMS blocks, using bot filtering to evade security scanners.

stories.title: PHP Issues Second Windows Security Update in Five Days to Fix Brotli Code Execution Flaw
stories.description: PHP updates Windows builds 8.2 through 8.5 to fix a Brotli flaw that could enable code execution through automatic cURL decompression.

stories.title: Microsoft Investigation Teams Issue Affecting Users in the United States
stories.description: Microsoft has restored Microsoft Teams service after investigating an issue affecting some users in the United States on October 26, 2026.

stories.title: Hackers Can Hijack OpenAI Codex and Claude Code Using Malicious Files in Downloads Folder
stories.description: A plain text file placed in the Downloads folder can trick AI coding agents into changing their settings, installing malware, or exposing login tokens.

stories.title: OpenBSD 8.0 Released With Major Security Hardening and Post-Quantum SSH Support
stories.description: OpenBSD 8.0 adds security fixes for its kernel, network services, firewall, and update tools, plus experimental post-quantum SSH signatures.

stories.title: Attackers Use Microsoft Teams IT Support Scams to Deploy Malware and Ransomware
stories.description: Attackers abuse Microsoft Teams external chats and fake IT support identities to gain remote access, deploy malware, and steal data.

stories.title: Industrial Vendors Check Products for PHP2Shell Vulnerabilities
stories.description: Siemens, Schneider Electric, ABB and others have confirmed that some of their products are affected by the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities.

stories.title: Genesys Hack Exposes Customer Data From Internal Systems
stories.description: The Genesys Cloud, Genesys Engage, and Genesys Engage Cloud platforms were not affected.

stories.title: Stolen AI Reasoning Could Help China Build Cheaper Rivals
stories.description: Xint says a flaw in OpenAI’s compaction process let researchers move reasoning traces between models, potentially making it cheaper to distill a rival AI.

stories.title: ⚡ Weekly Recap: This2Shell, That2Shell, Everything's an RCE? Rogue AI, Supply Chain Chaos and More
stories.description: This week's cybersecurity recap: Critical RCE flaws, millions of exploit attempts, rogue AI agents, supply chain attacks, leaked keys, and more.
